rawContent: There's a renewed discussion about older men manipulating teenage girls into relationships. I've decided I'm not taking part. I support you all but I lived through it and I've publicly talked about that all I care to. This is not the same as "silence". #SurvivingRKelly #metoo

I think where I'm diverging about "#MeToo humor" is that we may be caught up in a literalism and not detecting where sarcasm or other rhetorical styles can be possible. If Cuomo is a misogynist, it's because he believes his "joke" is a true statement.
